text.p: These were the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia on Moday at noon.
Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Defence minister Andrejs Krastinsh today handed in his resignation following disclosure of a shady fuel purchase deal of 290,000 tonnes for the country's navy.
- The procurator's office will decide whether the secretary of state for the defense ministry ,Einar Vaivods, should be tried for preparing the fuel purchase agreement.
- Sweden's conservative party will host a meeting of Baltic foreign ministers in Visby on May 7.
- The cabinet committee approved norms regarding state secrets.
